metadata.description: A bundled Claude Code marketplace of research, figure, and presentation skill packages: Light, academic-research-skills, nature-skills, econ-top-journal-writing, writing-ai-paper, auto-visio-helper, visio-image-rebuilder, frontend-slides, cyber-ppt, dashiai-ppt, ppt-master, and the Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills (AERS) stack (Stanford REAP x CoPaper.AI) with its 4 install-ready empirical-econometrics plugins plus a browsable 73-collection catalog.

plugins.name: light
plugins.description: Light — full-pipeline research skill pack (28 skills): literature search, data engineering, idea generation/critique, system & figure design, experiment analysis, paper drafting/polishing, citation, typesetting, peer-review rebuttal, patents/software-copyright, slides and competition materials. Ships 9 traceable knowledge bases and runnable code assets; keep the plugin intact.

plugins.name: academic-research-skills
plugins.description: Production-grade academic research pipeline (4 skills, 25 modes, multi-agent ensemble): research → write → review → revise → finalize, with deep-research, citation-verification gates, and a Material Passport pipeline.

plugins.name: nature-skills
plugins.description: Nature-style research skills (12): academic search, citation, data, figures, paper-to-patent, paper-to-PPT, polishing, reading/translation, reviewer response, peer review, scientific writing, plus an OpenClaw medical module.

plugins.name: econ-top-journal-writing
plugins.description: Economics top-journal writing workflow (5 skills): workflow router, English economics writing, Chinese top-journal writing, bilingual table/figure design, and a multi-agent writing controller.

plugins.name: writing-ai-paper
plugins.description: Writing AI Conference Papers — the beginner's handbook by hzwer and DingXiaoH, packaged as an invocable skill for planning, drafting, and revising NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR/CVPR-style papers.

plugins.name: auto-visio-helper
plugins.description: Auto Visio Helper (1 skill) — turn method descriptions, paper screenshots, or sketches into editable Microsoft Visio .vsdx diagrams via a spec-first workflow and local Visio COM automation. Ships references, demos, a reusable Visio template, and PNG/PDF/SVG preview export.

plugins.name: visio-image-rebuilder
plugins.description: Visio 图重建 Skill (1 skill: visio-image-rebuilder) — rebuild or restyle editable Microsoft Visio diagrams from reference images and existing .vsdx files, then export .vsdx/PNG/SVG/PDF/PPTX. Recreates paper figures as native shapes/text/connectors instead of embedding a flat image, with panel calibration and a default Chinese technical-bid flowchart mode (SimSun 12pt, fixed page box, VSDX-only batch output). Ships rebuild guidelines and Visio PowerShell/COM automation scaffolds.

plugins.name: frontend-slides
plugins.description: Frontend Slides (1 skill) — zero-dependency, animation-rich HTML presentation generator: build decks from scratch or convert PPT/PPTX to web, with safe presets, a bold template library, a fixed 16:9 stage, and an anti-AI-slop design philosophy.

plugins.name: cyber-ppt
plugins.description: CyberPPT — evidence-based, editable consulting-style PPT generation (1 skill): a three-stage pipeline (MBB evidence analysis + SCR storyline → 8 fixed visual styles + per-page ImageGen blueprints → hybrid high-fidelity editable PPTX) with render-based QA gates, an 11k+ SVG icon library, and PPTX validation scripts.

plugins.name: dashiai-ppt
plugins.description: DashiAI PPT — theme-based presentation generation (1 skill): turns natural-language requirements into a JSON plan, then renders an offline, browser-editable HTML deck from preset visual themes via a bundled local generator (React + pptxgenjs), with PPTX / PDF export.

plugins.name: ppt-master
plugins.description: Generate natively editable PPTX from PDF/DOCX/URL/Markdown — real DrawingML shapes, text boxes, charts, and animations via an AI multi-role SVG generation pipeline. Ships a large icon/template/reference library; run `pip install -r requirements.txt` inside skills/ppt-master/ for the Python post-processing scripts.

plugins.name: aer-skills
plugins.description: AER-skills (from Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills) — 14-skill stack for top-5 economics manuscripts (AER / AER: Insights / AEJ): topic selection, modern causal identification (DiD / IV / RDD / SCM / Bartik), referee-anticipating robustness, Keith-Head-style introductions, AER booktabs tables, AEA Data & Code Availability deposits (openICPSR-ready), submission preflight, and R&R rebuttal letters. Ships Stata / R / Python templates and classic-AER exemplars.

plugins.name: empirical-analysis-python
plugins.description: Explicit 8-step empirical-analysis pipeline in the traditional Python econometrics stack (pandas + statsmodels + linearmodels + pyfixest + rdrobust + econml + causalml): cleaning → variable construction → Table 1 → diagnostics → estimation (OLS/IV/DID/RDD/PSM/SCM/DML/Causal Forest) → robustness → mechanism/heterogeneity/mediation → publication-ready tables & figures. Includes epidemiology and ML-causal modes.

plugins.name: empirical-analysis-stata
plugins.description: Explicit 8-step empirical-analysis pipeline in the traditional Stata ecosystem (reghdfe + ivreg2 + csdid + did_imputation + sdid + rdrobust + synth + psmatch2 + teffects + esttab + coefplot): from use/import to .tex/.rtf tables and .pdf figures, with the full modern DID toolkit (bacondecomp + honestdid + rwolf + ritest). Includes epidemiology and ML-causal modes.

plugins.name: empirical-analysis-r
plugins.description: Explicit 8-step empirical-analysis pipeline in the modern tidyverse + econometrics R stack (dplyr + haven + fixest + did + synthdid + rdrobust + MatchIt + WeightIt + grf + DoubleML + mediation + marginaleffects + modelsummary). All eight steps fit in a single .qmd; `quarto render` produces a unified PDF/HTML/Word reproducibility report. Includes epidemiology and ML-causal modes.
